title: Category-colimit bar models and functorial bar systems
statement: Fix the universes of [def-weil-size-convention]. A category-colimit bar system is the following data, simultaneously for every small category $\mathcal E$ and commutative ring $R$. Give $\mathcal E$ the topology generated by singleton identity coverings [def-weil-pbc-sites-and-cohomology], put $\underline R$ for the constant ring, and identify its module sheaves with $\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R}=\operatorname{Fun}(\mathcal E^{op},\operatorname{Mod}_R)$ [def-weil-sheaf-of-modules-category]. The point data are a ringed-topos morphism to the one-object identity category with ring $R$ [def-weil-pbc-ringed-topos-morphism], its constant inverse image and identity structural map, and the module equivalence respecting evaluation and restriction. A bar model over $(\mathcal E,R)$ consists of an additive colimit functor $C=\operatorname{colim}_{\mathcal E^{op}}$ [def-weil-pbc-category-colimit], a functor $L:D(\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R})\to D(R)$ [def-weil-abstract-derived-category], and a universal left-derived comparison $\varepsilon_P:L(QP)\to Q(CP)$, pointwise defined on all complexes (also as an essentially constant pro-diagram for the quasi-isomorphism localization [def-pur-saturated-triangulated-localization]). It includes a shift compatibility, triangulatedness, and an adjunction to the derived constant functor whose transpose on $\varepsilon_P\circ Q(f)$ is the localized ordinary colimit-constant transpose of $f$. It includes an additive bar functor $K:\mathcal A_{\mathcal E,R}\to\operatorname{CoCh}(\operatorname{Mod}_R)$, coordinates $K(F)^{-n}\cong\bigoplus_{U_n\to\cdots\to U_0}F(U_0)$ for $n\geq0$, and zero positive terms. Write $\iota_{c}$ for the coordinate generator belonging to a chain $c$. Deleting the $j$th vertex from the left gives $\partial_jc$, composing adjacent arrows, and its coefficient map $r_j$ is the identity except at the rightmost vertex, where it is $F(U_1\to U_0)$. Require $d(\iota_c x)=\sum_j(-1)^j\iota_{\partial_jc}(r_jx)$ and $K(t)(\iota_cx)=\iota_c(t_{U_0}x)$. The model includes preservation of objectwise short exact sequences, a functorial augmented presheaf complex $a_F:B(F)\to F[0]$ which is a quasi-isomorphism and has $\varepsilon_{B(F)}$ invertible, and an isomorphism $b_F:CB(F)\cong K(F)$. Its derived comparison $m_F:L(Q(F[0]))\cong QK(F)$ is required to satisfy $m_F=Q(b_F)\circ\varepsilon_{B(F)}\circ L(Qa_F)^{-1}$; in degree zero, the coordinate summation $K(F)^0\to CF$ after $b_F$ agrees with $C(a_F^0)$. Include exactness of the degree-zero embedding and compatibility of $m$ with the connecting morphisms of short exact sequences, using the shift isomorphism of $L$. The system additionally supplies, for every functor $u:\mathcal E\to\mathcal D$, ring map $\rho:R\to S$, and natural map $t:F\to\operatorname{Res}_\rho(G\circ u^{op})$, a chain map $K(u,\rho,t):K_{\mathcal E,R}(F)\to\operatorname{Res}_\rho K_{\mathcal D,S}(G)$ taking $(U_n\to\cdots\to U_0,x)$ to $(uU_n\to\cdots\to uU_0,t_{U_0}x)$. These maps preserve identities and composition. For $R=S$ and $\rho=1$, supply a lift $B(F)\to u^{-1}B(G)$ respecting augmentations and inducing $K(u,1,t)$ after colimit and the canonical colimit reindexing comparison. Supply scalar-restriction isomorphisms $K_R(\operatorname{Res}_\rho G)\cong\operatorname{Res}_\rho K_S(G)$, identical on generators, and require $K(u,\rho,t)$ to factor through the same-ring map and this isomorphism. Include exactness after scalar restriction and commutation with connecting morphisms for every compatible morphism of objectwise short exact sequences. Finally, for $v,w:\mathcal E\to\mathcal D$, $\eta:v\Rightarrow w$ and $t:F\to\operatorname{Res}_\rho(G\circ w^{op})$, include a chain homotopy between $K(v,\rho,G(\eta)t)$ and $K(w,\rho,t)$ and equality of their localized maps. This defines a type of data with these laws, and does not assert its inhabitation.
